prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Cedar Falls Municipal Drinking Water Treatment Plant produces compliant potable water; boundary River Intake Pump Station(Ironwood)–High Service Pump Header(Juniper); distribution excluded. Chief Operator authorizes manual/Storm Intake Mode/recovery/emergency; automatic-control failure→Duty Engineer. Raw Water Screen Channel→Maintenance Planner(Quarry):Rake Torque Snapshot. Coagulant Dosing Skid(Marigold)→Alum Batch Ticket: Laboratory Technician verifies identity; Chief Operator approves dose; inconsistencies hold dose. Laboratory Sample Receiving Bench(Sparrow) receives custody-controlled samples→Jar Test Photograph Set/analytical status; Laboratory Technician→Sample Chain Slip; release requires quality-control review. North Filter Gallery(Cobalt)/South Filter Gallery monitor turbidity/headloss; South→Filter Run Exception Note; Cobalt verifies capacity. Recovery requires wash/turbidity/valve/flow verification; breakthrough requires approval/rinse-to-waste/stability. Backwash Recovery Tank return requires settling/sampling/clarity; Chief Operator→verified Backwash Solids Manifest; Residuals Hauler verifies commissioning-load identity/destination/acceptance. Chlorine Contact Basin/Clearwell Level Controller maintain contact/residual/storage/pumping alignment; controller→Clearwell Diver Entry Permit; Quarry verifies isolation. Duty Engineer reviews Chlorine Cylinder Seal Log before storage changes. Juniper→Pump Bearing Vibration Clip; Quarry uses clip for inspection/corrective priorities. North Distribution Pressure Station monitors pressure/availability/communications; readiness verifies telemetry/permissives/local-alarms/communications. South Distribution Pressure Station starts booster after low-pressure delay; uses Pressure Zone Handoff Card for readiness zone/valve/communications checks. Distribution Dispatcher(Falcon)→verified card; receives pressure/fire-flow failures; requires readiness-message acknowledgement before planned zone-status changes. Readiness requires pressure/storage/communications/emergency-path verification; restoration requires stability/alarm-disposition/fieldwork-accounting/approval. SCADA Historian Server links/retains records; commissioning verifies synchronization/tags/retention/trend-retrieval. Require least-privilege named accounts, approved changes, laboratory review/reporting-only access, remote MFA/encryption/approval/reason, weekly Quarry reviews, segmentation, tested updates. Chief Operator governs consequence/action-prioritized alarms; Duty Engineer reviews changes. Backup generator/UPS supports critical services; dual-power loss→emergency/notification. Commissioning tests intake/screen/filters/dosing local/supervisory response; Juniper startup/lead-lag/shutdown

New part:
S246: The Chemical Supplier Driver shall follow site access, unloading, verification, and communication procedures established during commissioning and confirmed during training.
S247: Records generated during commissioning and early operation shall be complete enough to support troubleshooting, regulatory review, warranty claims, and future operator training.
S248: Records retention shall follow municipal policy and applicable drinking water requirements, with electronic records protected against unauthorized change and accidental loss.
S249: Periodic performance reviews shall compare actual plant operation with the control concept, including alarm burden, manual interventions, water quality stability, chemical use, and energy use.
S250: Continuous improvement actions shall be prioritized by risk, reviewed by the Chief Operator and Duty Engineer, tested before release, and incorporated into updated procedures and training materials.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
